stem: Which of the following resulted from the U.S.-led military coalition’s engagement in the Persian Gulf War?

options.label: A
options.text: The Shah of Iran was overthrown.

options.label: B
options.text: Saddam Hussein was forced from power.

options.label: C
options.text: The nation of Kuwait was liberated.

options.label: D
options.text: Iraqi Kurds were granted equal rights.
